notes: The System T S500 is a modular broadcast audio mixing control surface (not a rack-mount unit), so rackUnits is omitted. Physical I/O extracted from SSL's official "System T Installation Guide" (Part no. 82BL5G01N, hosted at livehelp.solidstatelogic.com), which is the only source found with a full connector-level breakdown — SSL's own product page (solidstatelogic.com/products/s500) and retailer listings (Vintage King) describe the modular tile/frame architecture but omit connector specifics. The S500 audio signal path itself carries no direct analog/digital audio I/O of its own (audio arrives via Dante from separate Network I/O stageboxes such as SB 8.8, SB 32.24, MADI Bridge, etc., which are sold as distinct products) — the console's own physical ports are network (OCP/Dante/Studio Integration/Remote Surface, all Gigabit Ethernet per SSL's system-wide Gigabit requirement, though the individual console port speed is not separately re-stated), USB/HDMI for its internal KVM and service/sidecar connections, GPIO via 25-way D-type connectors, one passive talkback XLR mic input, and redundant IEC mains. Two connector-panel variants exist (single- vs twin-touchscreen); the Overview HDMI output only appears on the single-touchscreen variant, noted on that port. Grades applied only to RJ45/USB/HDMI ports whose speed/version is explicitly documented; the GPI/GPO D-type connectors have no matching enum value (25-pin D-sub), so "rs232" was used as the closest available id and flagged in each port's note — this is not an actual RS232 serial connection.

ports.note: Port for production automation and DAW control
